calls.reasoning: Reference class: friendlies between mid-tier CONMEBOL/top-40 sides and low-ranked (~140-150) Asian hosts, typically ~2.5-3 total goals, mostly from the favourite. Paraguay score ~1.8/game and are very tight defensively (4 clean sheets in 5), and are likely to rotate before playing Japan four days later. Singapore concede heavily vs stronger teams (0-6 vs Malaysia, 1-3 vs Thailand) but score little. Market: no totals market found; Polymarket 'Will Singapore vs Paraguay end in a draw?' Yes 0.20 (volume not visible, page geo-blocked) is a partial-match contract that implies a fairly tight game; one preview site leaned Under 2.5. Model: Paraguay ~1.9 xG, Singapore ~0.6, total ~2.5 Poisson-like, slightly wider for rout risk.
